description: A glass button with a band of light circling its edge: it is drawn toward the cursor, dims with distance, and flashes once on click.
interactionNotes: The light travels along the button's perimeter, not inside it: as the cursor comes near, it sticks to the nearest point on the edge and dims with distance; inside the button it slides slightly toward the cursor, and a click gives a brief shine. With `autoAnimate`, it circles the edge by itself when the cursor is away. The light is rendered in WebGL2; if the browser doesn't support it, the glass body and text stay in place with CSS.

props.href: If given, the button becomes a link (`<a>`); without it, a `<button>`.
props.size: Size; padding and font change together.
props.radius: Corner radius, pixels. Above half the height means a pill.
props.tint: The glass body color; any CSS color format.
props.tintOpacity: Body color density, 0 to 1. Zero to put a gradient behind the button.
props.lineColor: Color of the light on the edge.
props.baseColor: Color of the thin hairline that is always visible beneath the light.
props.idleIntensity: How much light remains when the cursor is away, 0 to 1.
props.shineSize: How much of the perimeter the light covers at its peak, in degrees.
props.shineFade: How far the light fades out, in degrees.
props.thickness: Width of the lit edge, pixels.
props.glow: Soft halo around the edge and inside the glass; zero means just the sharp line.
props.followMouse: Whether the light sticks to the point on the edge nearest the cursor.
props.proximity: The distance closer than which the light starts following, pixels.
props.autoAnimate: Whether the light circles the edge by itself when the cursor is away.
props.disabled: Turns off the button and the light.
props.className: Extra class for the button itself.
props.style: Inline style (applied after the color variables).

tips: It looks best on a dark surface; for a light theme, make the glass and text dark (the demo's default does this).
`href` renders a plain `<a>` so the code works in any project; if you want Next's soft navigation, navigate to the destination in `onClick` with `router.push`.
Take the body color from `tint`, not `background`. If you pass `bg-brand-grad`, set `tintOpacity={0}` so the flat color doesn't sit on top of the gradient.
For small buttons, lower `thickness` and `glow` — a wide light on a short height reads as a mistake.
The ring only spins while something is changing; at rest and in a hidden tab it does zero work.
